title: Beztack Sync event log
description: Schema-versioned append-only audit trail of Template sync actions and Promotions for a Derived project. The Sync event log is the source of truth for audit history; current machine-readable status belongs in Sync state (sync-state.schema.json), not here. Engines append entries on each planning or apply action and never mutate or reorder existing entries.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Engines must refuse unknown values before planning or applying a Template update.

derivedProjectId.description: Opaque stable Derived project identifier generated at scaffolding.

currentRevision.description: Template revision the Derived project last accepted. Mirrored from the Origin baseline so the log is useful even if Origin baseline is absent; the Origin baseline remains the canonical source.

events.description: Append-only entries. Engines MUST only append; existing entries are immutable.

eventSchemaVersion.description: Per-event schema version. Distinct from the file-level schemaVersion so future revisions can introduce new event types without forcing a log file rewrite.

eventId.description: Opaque stable identifier for the event (ULID or similar). Engines generate this when appending.

type.description: Event type. schema-rejected records an attempt that the engine refused at validation time, so the audit trail also covers invalid inputs.

syncEngine.description: Sync engine that recorded the event. Versioned separately from the Template version per ADR-0006.

details.description: Type-specific payload. The shape is constrained per type.

revision.description: Template revision accepted as the new Origin baseline.

filesRecorded.description: Number of files captured in the new Origin baseline.

branch.description: Branch the engine prepared for the Template update. PR-only by construction (ADR-0006).

label.description: Promotion label applied to the source PR (e.g. 'promotion: candidate').

sourcePR.description: Optional reference (URL or identifier) to the source PR on the Derived project.

file.description: Path (Derived-project-relative) of the schema-versioned file the engine refused.

schemaVersion.description: The schemaVersion value the engine observed.

supportedVersions.description: Schema versions the engine accepts. Rejection means the value was not in this list.
